note: fixed by 35140fb (test: tools/test/orchestrator.test.mjs 'added-code check: a failed or cut-off git diff counts as sensitive (fail closed)'). The diff command's added-code scan ignores git's exit status and spawnSync's default 1 MB maxBuffer: a failed or cut-off 'git diff -U0' yields empty or partial output, so a diff that adds auth code is reported as not sensitive and the security reviewer is skipped (fail open).
